versions.changelog:
Initial release. Provides end-to-end support for work injury determination and insurance claims nationwide.

- Supports injury scenario assessment, personalized materials checklist, disability assessment guidance, benefit calculation, and local rules lookup.
- Automatically generates key documents: claim applications and compensation statements.
- Tailored guidance for regional policy differences and complex scenarios (e.g., commuting accidents, third-party claims, employment status).
- Includes important legal deadlines, calculation formulas, and practical tips.
- Information is for reference only; users are advised to consult professionals for legal decisions.
